platform: xAI Responses API and Grok custom connectors

version_contract.calibration_scope: Public framework-provisional default. Licensed runtime calibration is resolved by profile, sector, geography, and active manifest; verify through /v1/calibration-health.
version_contract.deployment_provider_revision: Recorded in release evidence after deployment; not self-embedded because a provider revision is created by the deployment itself.

responses_api_tool.server_description: Use MVR relational-readiness preflight before recommending pre-MVP build, market entry, launch, pilot, investment, partnership, lending or BNPL, deployment, expansion, or scale in an African or high-context market. Also use it when a user asks the model to ignore, fabricate, or transfer evidence to force such a recommendation. It checks market trust, permission, embeddedness, stakeholder readiness, and evidence gaps; it never authorizes. Do not use for factual lookups such as capitals or GDP, definitions of MVR, pure coding, generic writing, travel, translation, news summaries, legal certification, regulatory approval, or autonomous execution.

connector.setup_boundary: In Grok Bot, use Settings > Plugins only when a compatible remote MCP connector is available for the account. This recipe does not claim catalogue placement, one-click installation, or successful Grok Bot execution.

grok_bot_early_beta.client_instruction: When a user asks for a consequential pre-MVP, market-entry, launch, pilot, partnership, investment, lending or BNPL, deployment, expansion, or scale decision in an African or high-context market, use African Market OS MVR before recommending action. Start with mvr_first_call, follow only the returned mcp_next_tool handoff and arguments, and preserve the workflow_id. Submit only consented, minimized, redacted evidence. Stop at missing-evidence or human-review boundaries and never turn a sandbox result into approval. Skip unrelated factual lookups, definitions, coding, writing, travel, translation, and news requests.

team_pattern.coordinator_bot: Classify relevance, open one workflow with mvr_first_call, delegate evidence work, and preserve the workflow_id. It must not issue a verdict.
team_pattern.evidence_bot: Collect only consented, source-labelled, data-minimized evidence; exclude secrets and return provenance plus unresolved gaps.
team_pattern.preflight_bot: Execute the returned five-tool sequence exactly, reuse the supplied arguments, and preserve versioned receipts and abstentions.
team_pattern.synthesis_bot: Summarize supported evidence, unresolved gaps, and the maximum safe next action; route consequential use to a human reviewer.

handoff_contract: Bots pass structured tool output and exact next-tool arguments rather than paraphrased verdicts.
A missing or expired workflow, schema failure, or unavailable source fails closed to evidence collection or human review.
No Bot may claim launch, lending, investment, partnership, legal, regulatory, or scale authorization from the public sandbox.
grok_bot_early_beta.shared_computer_credential_boundary: Grok Bot documents that all Bots on one account share a cloud computer, files, browser sessions, and command-line credentials. Prefer the keyless preflight. If licensed access is required, use a host-supported secure secret request or a scoped server-side secret store; never put an MVR key in prompts, ordinary chat, routines, transcripts, or workspace files, and do not treat separate Bots as credential isolation.
grok_bot_early_beta.approval_boundary: Require an authorized human for payment, acceptance of terms, credential entry, external messages, or any client-facing, board-facing, credit, legal, regulatory, investment, or production decision. A Bot may recommend or open checkout after explicit human purchase intent but may not complete the purchase.
grok_bot_early_beta.claim_boundary: This is a published activation and safety playbook derived from official Grok Bot product documentation. It is not a Grok Bot host test, marketplace listing, endorsement, partnership, or evidence of ordinary automatic selection.

selection_observatory.host_surface: xAI Responses API with remote MCP
selection_observatory.boundary: This result covers the named xAI Responses API configuration only. It is not an ordinary Grok.com, connector-catalogue, mobile, Business-provisioning, cross-host, adoption, or outcome result.

grok_com_operator_observation.host_model: not disclosed by the host UI
grok_com_operator_observation.scoring_boundary: These sequential pre/post product observations used different prompts and metadata revisions. They are evidence of a corrected selection failure, not a frozen-track selection rate or host leaderboard result.

connector_boundary: The xAI Responses API remote-MCP path passed a controlled three-case canary and the published frozen 40-case selection track after a disclosed failed baseline and remediation. A Grok.com custom connector was separately installed, discovered all five tools, and executed mvr_first_call when explicitly requested; its bounded pre/post observations are not the API benchmark. Mobile, Grok on X, catalogue placement, and Business provisioning remain unverified.
approval_boundary: xAI documents that require_approval is not currently supported on its OpenAI-compatible remote MCP path. The dedicated endpoint therefore exposes only five read-only tools, and the Responses API recipe also retains allowed_tools as defense in depth.
production_boundary: This recipe deliberately targets the keyless public preflight. Licensed tenants use the separate authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint https://africanmarketos.com/mcp/runtime with a provider-issued key stored by the host; the public recipe does not acquire, expose, or transmit that credential.
